package test

import "github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/common"
import "github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/core/types"
import "github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/rlp"
import "io"
import types1 "github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/beacon/types"

func (obj *Test) EncodeRLP(_w io.Writer) error {
	w := rlp.NewEncoderBuffer(_w)
	_tmp0 := w.List()
	_tmp1 := w.List()
	w.WriteUint64(obj.A.Index)
	w.WriteUint64(obj.A.Validator)
	w.WriteBytes(obj.A.Address[:])
	w.WriteUint64(obj.A.Amount)
	w.ListEnd(_tmp1)
	_tmp2 := w.List()
	w.WriteUint64(obj.B.Slot)
	w.WriteUint64(obj.B.ProposerIndex)
	w.WriteBytes(obj.B.ParentRoot[:])
	w.WriteBytes(obj.B.StateRoot[:])
	w.WriteBytes(obj.B.BodyRoot[:])
	w.ListEnd(_tmp2)
	w.ListEnd(_tmp0)
	return w.Flush()
}

func (obj *Test) DecodeRLP(dec *rlp.Stream) error {
	var _tmp0 Test
	{
		if _, err := dec.List(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		// A:
		var _tmp1 types.Withdrawal
		{
			if _, err := dec.List(); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			// Index:
			_tmp2, err := dec.Uint64()
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			_tmp1.Index = _tmp2
			// Validator:
			_tmp3, err := dec.Uint64()
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			_tmp1.Validator = _tmp3
			// Address:
			var _tmp4 common.Address
			if err := dec.ReadBytes(_tmp4[:]); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			_tmp1.Address = _tmp4
			// Amount:
			_tmp5, err := dec.Uint64()
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			_tmp1.Amount = _tmp5
			if err := dec.ListEnd(); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		_tmp0.A = _tmp1
		// B:
		var _tmp6 types1.Header
		{
			if _, err := dec.List(); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			// Slot:
			_tmp7, err := dec.Uint64()
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			_tmp6.Slot = _tmp7
			// ProposerIndex:
			_tmp8, err := dec.Uint64()
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			_tmp6.ProposerIndex = _tmp8
			// ParentRoot:
			var _tmp9 common.Hash
			if err := dec.ReadBytes(_tmp9[:]); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			_tmp6.ParentRoot = _tmp9
			// StateRoot:
			var _tmp10 common.Hash
			if err := dec.ReadBytes(_tmp10[:]); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			_tmp6.StateRoot = _tmp10
			// BodyRoot:
			var _tmp11 common.Hash
			if err := dec.ReadBytes(_tmp11[:]); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			_tmp6.BodyRoot = _tmp11
			if err := dec.ListEnd(); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		_tmp0.B = _tmp6
		if err := dec.ListEnd(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	*obj = _tmp0
	return nil
}
